coverage_questions: This reconstruction is restricted to the approximately 3.6B GenNA model. The paper documents a separate 0.36B version but does not establish whether its input construction, tokenizer, decoder, or receiving component differs.
The paper does not specify tokenizer special-token behavior, padding values, attention masks, loss masks, sequence-boundary handling, or the exact segmentation of packed inputs into context windows.
The paper does not provide the exact decoder input/label shift used for causal language-model training.
The paper does not document the internal Transformer computation that converts token IDs into hidden states, logits, or next-token distributions.
The paper does not specify whether optional species and gene fields are represented by omission, empty fields, or special tokens.
The paper does not provide the exact implementation of softmax, repetition penalties, no-repeat n-gram filtering, or termination handling beyond the stated decoding description.
The paper does not document the exact extraction and translation implementation used for generated CDS evaluation; those procedures are downstream validation rather than model-input construction.
The paper does not specify the exact implementation of conditional perplexity, mutation ΔPPL, or species-label ΔPPL beyond defining their input comparisons and reported metrics.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper explicitly describes parsing GenBank records and extracting molecule type, species, gene name, functional descriptions, and annotated regions, but the catalog has no operation for structured-record parsing or field extraction.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Hierarchical annotation organization with XML-style tags
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper documents preservation of hierarchical mRNA, CDS, ncRNA, and regulatory-element boundaries using custom XML-style tags. The catalog has no operation for constructing hierarchical structural annotations.

The catalog represents attention primitives but has no operation for the complete decoder-only Transformer stack with causal masking and next-token distribution output. The paper does not expose an operation-level decomposition of that stack.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Masked mean pooling across the sequence dimension
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent exclusion of padding with selection, but it has no mean-pooling operation whose output is the fixed-dimensional average described in the paper.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Logits-to-probability conversion with temperature scaling, nucleus filtering, repetition penalty, and no-repeat n-gram filtering
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has a sampling operation and can retain documented controls as invocation parameters, but it has no separate operation for the complete logits transformation and candidate-set filtering pipeline.
